newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes softer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes softer in quiet trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its American counterpart in light trade on Monday and dealers expected quiet sentiment to continue.

The local unit rose slightly in the morning but importer demand for the American currency emerged later. Some dealers said the government's recent decision to allow two major state funds to invest in stocks could trigger foreign fund inflows, strengthening Taiwan dollar. "But the market should mainly focus on foreign trends and move narrowly," said one dealer.
The local unit ended at T$27.501 against Saturday's T$27.496 finish. Turnover was US$149 million. - Joyce Liu (2-5080815)
